name: The Four Dukes
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The links between the Twilight's Hammer and the Abyssal Council are proving to be more important than we had expected.

We believe the elemental nobles known as the Abyssal Dukes are one of the primary force organizing the Twilight's Hammer cultists.  Find a way to lure the four Abyssal Dukes into our plane of existence and destroy them!

Your dedication and prowess in past assignments have led us to choose you for this particular assignment.  We are certain you will succeed in this endeavor.
narrative.objectives: Find a way to summon and slay the Duke of Cynders, the Duke of Fathoms, the Duke of Zephyrs and the Duke of Shards and report back to Commander Mar'alith in Cenarion Hold.  You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing V in order to complete this quest.
narrative.offerRewardText: You have achieved a great accomplishment for our cause today, adventurer. You've vanquished some of our most powerful enemies. For that I greatly commend you.
narrative.requestItemsText: Is your task done yet, adventurer?

giverName: an item: Tactical Task Briefing V
